clips.title: The story
paras: Near Wellspring Lake, Silvery Spinnerets are harvested from Lady Sathrah in northern Teldrassil. Her silver webs once gathered healing evening dew for the Temple of the Moon. The Sisterhood of Elune seeks the spinnerets for a sacred rite honoring her soul.

Lady Sathrah once spun shimmering webs by moonlight near Wellspring Lake. Her silver silk gathered evening mist into healing dew prized by the Sisterhood of Elune in Darnassus. But corruption reached her in Teldrassil, driving her into violent madness. Sathrah threatened her brood and the surrounding forest. Priestess A'moora asks travelers to end her suffering and recover her spinnerets, bringing mercy to a once-revered creature of the great boughs.
